messages.displayText:
Hey, do you know
about Potions? <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Do you know about Potions?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
You should take some and use them on your
Pokémon when they’ve gotten hurt in battle!

Using Potions is a great way to heal up your
Pokémon without visiting a Pokémon Center!

Would you care
for a sample? <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

We’re giving away one Lumiose Galette on the
house for new customers.
I can only give one sample per customer, sorry!

You got enough
Poké Balls? <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

You’ll want to have plenty of Poké Balls on hand
if you’re mucking about in a wild zone.
Use <U+0010><U+0002>봊<U+0002>ZL to aim well, then let those Poké Balls fly!

It’s so handy knowing
all the travel spots! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

You should make a habit of swinging by new
Pokémon Centers whenever you spy one!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
That way, they’ll be registered as a <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>travel spot<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>
on your map.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
And to help you register this handy bit of info in
your brain, here: a Swift Feather to remind you!

The more you explore Lumiose City, the easier it
becomes to get around!

Boy, these rewards for
Mable’s research! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

I got a reward from Mable for catching all the
species that can be found here in Wild Zone 3.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I’m feeling so good that I’ll share some luck with
you—here, have some of my extra Poké Balls!

Working hard on those research tasks for Mable
is seriously worth the effort!

A Holovator! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

I don’t really get how Holovators work, but they’ve
got some fancy tech that warps you up and down!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I’m so shocked by how cool they are that I gotta
give you something to share how I feel!

You should totally give Holovators a try whenever
you come across one!

Money doesn’t grow
on trees, but... <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

You should keep your eyes peeled for sparkling
things on the ground around Lumiose City.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
If you pick them up and sell them, you can
become rich in no time at all!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Here, I’ll even gift you some Tiny Mushrooms
I found on the ground, so you can see for yourself.<U+0010><U+0001>븀
Just sell them at the Pokémon Center!

The best part is that the sparkles just keep on
coming back! It’s endless money!

I’ve got good
stuff here! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

I’m all out of crêpes for the day, but I’ve still got
good things to share! Here, how about this?<U+0010><U+0001>븀
Your very own Quick Claw!

If you have your Pokémon hold a Quick Claw, it
might get to use its moves faster sometimes!

Time for some shopping! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Have you considered selling some Pretty Feathers
so you can get some pretty fashion instead?

Remember: you can change outfits at any time by
opening the main menu, then pressing <U+0010><U+0002>봊<U+0005>Minus!

Exp. Candies?! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Do you know about Exp. Candies?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
When a Pokémon eats an Exp. Candy, it just gains
Exp. Points somehow—no joke! I’ll give you a few<U+0010><U+0001>븀
so you can feed some to your Pokémon and see.

Exp. Candies that give out Exp. Points... I bet it
was an adult who came up with that idea.

TMs! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

When I wish I could crawl into a hole and simply
disappear, but I can’t find a hole to crawl into...<U+0010><U+0001>븀
that’s the perfect time for the move Dig!

Dig lets Pokémon burrow underground and hide
for a bit, then pop back up to attack their target!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Being underground is perfect when you just wish
no one could see you!

Tourist Tips, hm? <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

You should read up on any Tourist Tips you’ve got,
then go for a nice stroll around town and explore!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
And remember to stay hydrated while you’re doing
all that walking. Here—have a bottle of water!

You can always review Tourist Tips from the main
menu too. Just press <U+0010><U+0002>봊<U+0001>L from there!

I need a taxi
over here! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Taxis are a great way to reach a place you’ve
never visited before! And once you get there...<U+0010><U+0001>븀
you’ll have a new travel spot for the future!

The drivers’ chatter can be real hit-or-miss,
though, and you’re stuck sitting through it...

Berries sure are
mysterious! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Berries sure are mysterious! You’d never be able
to tell by looking at them, but they have all kinds<U+0010><U+0001>븀
of effects. Wouldn’t you like to try one out?

You should check the descriptions of your Berries
and use them to great effect!

With this TM... <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

I can see into the very future!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
And what I see is myself...giving you a TM!

If you use the move Future Sight, then a little
while in the future, a blast of psychic energy will<U+0010><U+0001>븀
hit the spot where your target was standing!

Are you very into
taking photos? <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Isn’t it amazing all the things you can capture in
your photos just by pressing <U+0010><U+0002>봊<U+0005>Minus?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
It’s a rare treat to have so many options to play
around with! And speaking of rare treats—here!

Go on and take tons of photos with <U+0010><U+0002>봊<U+0005>Minus!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
You can use filters or different background tunes
to change the vibe of your shots—have fun<U+0010><U+0001>븀
messing about!

I’m going for the
full course next! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

I’m going to try my hand at a full course of battles
at a restaurant!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
It’s important to immerse yourself in all kinds of
new experiences, don’t you think?

I think I’ll start with... Yes! It’ll have to be the
one-star Restaurant Le Nah!

Colorful Screws! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Life is so much better when it’s full of color!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Here—have a Lumiose Galette on me as a little
treat. The stand there makes the best ones!

If you ever find any Colorful Screws, you should
take them to Racine Construction!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
You can find their office farther up along this
street here, on the other side of the road.

I’m going to buy
a Mega Stone! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

You know, your Pokémon can’t battle if they’ve
fainted.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
And if they can’t battle, they can’t Mega Evolve!
So take a Revive that’ll get ’em back in top shape!

You can buy Mega Stones at the <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Stone Emporium<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>
over on Vernal Avenue. But they’re not cheap!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
You might need to earn some extra money in the
Z-A Royale first.

Your heart
is MINE! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

It’s the move that can catch someone’s heart and
never let it go! Take this TM for Electroweb!

Electroweb throws out an electrified net that’ll
catch opponents to deal damage to them.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
It’s totally captivating, just like my beloved Iono!

These pesky messes
Pokémon leave behind... <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

It’s such a pain how wild Pokémon leave stuff all
over town. Leave no trace behind, am I right?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Though at least clearing it away does allow you to
save up plenty of Mega Shards...

It can be a real headache to figure out what move
to use on the mess. It’s not like the same moves<U+0010><U+0001>븀
work on rocks or brambles or sludge or whatever!

Fantastic hair is the key
to being fashionable! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

I just adore it! A pretty new hairstyle, Pretty
Feathers all about—let’s fill this world with glam!

I’ve got my eyes on Coiffure Clips for my next do.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
They can do such wonders with cuts and styles,
so I think I’ll have them do my hair soon!

My favorite
move... <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1
Here...

The move Curse...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
It works differently for Ghost types...than for any
other types... Only ghosts can lay a true curse...

Wait—which way is
up on this map? <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Is it this way? Or...no, this way? Ugh, I’m so lost!
This is just mega...mega mega annoying!

Sorry for getting so sharp with you. I just got so
darn confused!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Did you know you can set your map so it rotates
based on which way you’re facing? It’s in the<U+0010><U+0001>븀
settings in the main menu.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Some people might like that dizzying whirl, but I
think I’m going back to a nice steady outlook!

The Poké Ball
Boutique! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1
Here—think fast!

I got that from the store over there! It’s called the
<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Poké Ball Boutique<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>—it sells unusual Poké Balls!

I’m making bank
tonight, for sure! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Nothing’s more heartening than earning a tidy
sum in the battle zone! Or maybe one of these!

Win a whole ton in one night to earn big bucks!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
And if you don’t want to waste your time running
back to the Pokémon Center, use Potions well too!

I can help your Pokémon
team feel all better! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

I was working as a crêpe seller up until about a
week ago, but I decided a change was in order!<U+0010><U+0001>븀
So now this is my own little Pokémon Center!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I’ll just need your Pokémon for a few seconds!

I’m your friendly traveling Pokémon Center, here
to conveniently help heal your team!
Your <U+0010><U+0002>ā<U+0002> should be all better now!

I make Pokémon
feel all better! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1
